newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar technically weak, awaits NY raws.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar technically weak, awaits NY raws.

text.p: White sugar futures barely stirred on Thursday morning with spot October content to hover in a lower corrective range after the fund-led gains seen earlier in the week, traders said.
By 1135 GMT just 131 lots were posted on the board, mostly in October. The contract was unchanged at $327.70 and December was down $1.30 at $321.50.
London traders said most attention would be centred on the open of the New York raws market, where October has been struggling with support at 11.55 cents/lb.
U.S. market sources have said October raws could test 11.55 again on Thursday, with a move below 11.55 cents seen as likely to attract substantial fund selling.

Further weakness in New York could prompt a renewal of Wednesday's trading pattern in the London market, where nearby prices have been steady but still vulnerable to an overspill of bearish sentiment in the raws.
Technical analysts said the London market had been slightly overbought after October rallied to score a new contract high of $331.00 on Monday, and now appeared to be in a corrective mode.
"The RSI was looking a little overbought and now that it is turning lower we would not be surprised to see a test of $326.80," said Adrian Haylor, analyst at Sucden.
"Longer term, we remain bullish and look for a test of $335," he added.
In Paris, trading was confined to just two lots of October, up 50 cents at $328.00. Nothing was traded on the Matif exchange's lesser-quality 100 ICUMSA market.
